body: Self-test technique for the Electron desktop app without a display: apps/desktop/scripts/shot.cjs uses BrowserWindow webPreferences.offscreen:true + app.disableHardwareAcceleration() + a 'paint' listener + capturePage()→PNG. shot-preload.cjs stubs window.filemark so the renderer hydrates with empty state. Run via 'task shot' (apps/desktop) → /tmp/desk-shot-light.png + -dark.png; the agent Reads the PNGs to visually verify. 2026-05-19: confirmed UI renders correctly in BOTH themes (controls, Open Folder button, empty states, kbd chip) — the missing-token-CSS bug is visually resolved. Limitation: stub bridge shows empty states only; offscreen can't reproduce window-GC/lifecycle bugs (those are code-reasoned).
